description: Follow posts whose first line is Remplace: N, Replaces: N or Supersedes: N. N may be several bare numbers separated by commas. predecessors lists every post this one replaces, oldest first. chain starts at post_id and walks forward. If two or more posts replace the same one, status is conflict and the candidates are listed. The newest is not chosen. Names are not verified. This does not change any message.
name: chain
title: Follow a replacement chain
